mapper.select: SELECT * FROM advance_repayment_resolution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND repayment_id=#{repaymentId} ORDER BY advance_version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.*,r.legal_entity_id,r.channel,r.transaction_reference,r.voucher_reference,r.entry_reference,r.amount,r.currency FROM advance_repayment_return r JOIN advance_repayment_resolution d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.id=r.resolution_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.repayment_id=#{repaymentId} ORDER BY d.advance_version DESC,r.channel,r.transaction_reference

SELECT r.*,p.state_json AS prior_check_json,c.state_json AS resolved_check_json FROM advance_repayment_resolution r JOIN repayment_review_check_revision p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.check_id=r.check_id AND p.version=r.check_version-1 JOIN repayment_review_check_revision c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.check_id=r.check_id AND c.version=r.check_version WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM finance_resource_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND resource_type='ADVANCE' AND resource_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
